utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I marked the hammer, screwdrivers, and the drill for light cleaning. And just to note, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli. What time on Sunday should I tell people to come by?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet on the time—I'll check and get back to you. Thanks for passing the update along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure — I’ll check on pickup, and you can sort the timing. That should make the repair drive a lot easier.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — that really helps. I’ll keep sorting the timing, and please let me know as soon as you hear who’s picking them up.

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, see you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Sam — I appreciate it, and I’ll send along any updates right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring the screwdriver, and I’ll check for the box cutter, extra screws, tape measure, and spare batteries too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, that should cover us for the repair drive. Thanks, Bo!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — after the school run works for me too. Just send me the time when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Faye — I’ll send you the time as soon as I’ve got it, and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Gus — I’ll keep after the school run free and wait for your time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We should start with anything unsafe first, like loose steps, leaky faucets, or broken fixtures, then work down the list from there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That makes sense, Gus. Could you help me confirm which unsafe repairs are on top so I can write them down?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure — top of the list should be loose steps, leaking faucets, and any broken fixtures that could cause a hazard.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — that should cover the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to help — I’m all set then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then we’re covered for the repair drive. Thanks again, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye — just send me the plan and drop-off time when it’s set, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — I’ll line it up after the school run and send you the drop-off time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No rush, Faye — just send it through when it’s set, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — I appreciate you checking. Just send the list when you can, and I’ll help with whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll send over the list once I’ve checked, and we’ll meet Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Sunday at the community center works for me — just send the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, Uli — just so you know, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. Sunday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Glad to hear it, Uli — I’ll let you know if anything else changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, send it over and I’ll check the timing and supplies for any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll send the repair drive plan over now so you can check the timing and supplies for any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect — I’ll look for any gaps in timing or supplies once it comes through.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, quick update — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center now, so I’ll spread that around and make sure folks know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate you spreading the update and helping with the tool-sorting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it—I’ll keep spreading the word and point folks to the tool-sorting table on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, Quinn — I’ve got Sunday at the community center noted and I’ll keep an eye out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Sunday at the community center at 3. See you in the parking lot!

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, see you Sunday at 3 in the parking lot at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update and check the task list once you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll swing by the shops and check on the urgent fixes first, then I’ll report back with anything I learn.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll check the task list and wait for your update when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort the donated tools and match them with the right repair jobs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Rey—thank you. I’ll make sure everyone knows to bring the donated tools to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’m glad to help. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center with my gloves ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam — thanks for being ready. I’ll let you know if anything changes before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — just keep me posted if anything changes before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Nell — I’ll stick to the drill and screws and check back if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.text: Ira: Of course, Jules — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I’d appreciate that. Just let me know if you hear any updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it, Jules — I’ll pass along anything I hear while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it’s still on — we’re just tying up a few loose ends. I can fill you in on what’s left to fix.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, just checking — it’s definitely still happening, then?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, definitely still happening. We’ve just got a couple small things left to sort out, and then we’re good to go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, I can help carry things over if you want. Just let me know where to meet you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — just meet me by the front steps and I’ll point you to the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll meet you by the front steps and help carry the boxes over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. Since it’s Sunday at the community center now, what should we bring or set up?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think just the tool box, some extension cords, and maybe a fold-out table for the parts. Oh—and if anyone has tape or spare bulbs, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring the tool box and see about the table. I’ll also ask around for tape and spare bulbs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still on then? I’ll wait for your final details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on. I’ll send the final details soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
